metadata.body:
Adds the 11 remaining PHP HTTP conformance scenarios from #139 on top of #65.

- Server: CakePHP, CodeIgniter, Laravel, PSR-15, Symfony, WordPress, and Yii
- Client: curl, PSR-18, ReactPHP, and Symfony HTTP Client

Each fixture has pinned Composer dependencies and live Weaver coverage data. CI now installs the extensions required by the full PHP matrix.
